notes: Hold the Line first playable: lobby (host/find/browse), map/race/color picks, 1vX match, vs AI, early-wave vote
Play in portrait or landscape
Shared base (250 HP/defender), lane per defender, grid + drag-to-build with 3s construction, redesigned towers
Slower Footman/Scout, attacker unit-speed upgrade, Build button hides while a tower is selected
Empty health bar flashes for 0.2s when a unit dies
Removed Start Now vote; empty health bar lingers 0.4s and is easier to see
Empty health bar lingers 0.25s
Archer Post fires two arrows (one per archer, 13 dmg each), second 0.15-0.35s after the first
Build tray info strip (tap a tower for its stats); Done button sits above the tray
Defender spells: Meteor and Water Jet (drag or tap to cast, 20s cooldowns); sound effects and music
Meteor direct-hit radius halved (90 -> 45)
New units (Skeleton Horde, Naga, Warg Rider, Ogre Warchief, Tarrasque) unlocking over the match; ragdoll deaths with sprawls and limb loss for every unit
Fix: hosted lobbies now appear in Browse/Find (lobby directory rejected 5-seat lobbies)
11 new units: Zombie Horde, Gnoll Pack, Goblin Sapper, Shieldwall, Mounted Knight, Troll Berserker, Necromancer, Ent, Iron Golem, Siege Ram, War Mammoth
No wave timer: attacker units march out the moment they're sent; Meteor 125g, Water Jet 100g; attacker unit row scrolls
Fix: Goblin Sappers target the closest tower in range that isn't knocked out or claimed; dead sappers release their tower; range ring shown
Build drag: tray steps aside, drop on the bottom-middle cancel box to cancel; camera can pan past the bottom edge in build mode so the base area is reachable
10-second setup period at match start; full refund on towers sold within 10s of placing if they haven't dealt damage
AI defenders: add AI to any defender seat; new Attack vs AI mode; smarter AI tower choices
Archer Post levels 1-5 (30g base, staggered volleys, new looks), level-up panel with locked promotions, per-level build animations, recorded building sound

Attack rhythm: 30s sending, 15s pause. Attacker income now grows from sending. Leak damage scales with unit cost (min 1); leaks pay defenders half bounty. Base HP 300 per defender. Tarrasque 200g. Level-up rebuild 1.5s. Quieter water jet.
Firebreather replaces the Fire Brazier: dancing fire-breather, cone of flame through crossed torches, 5s burn, 5 levels with new looks. Units no longer rubber-band on the outside of bends.
Fix: Firebreather tower menu (crashed and showed another tower's info, no upgrade button); spell buttons hide while a tower menu is open

Invest removed: income grows from sending (+0.25% of gold sent). Hoarding tax: a big bank cuts income, down to half. Units 5% slower; speed upgrade +5%/level. Spell buttons moved to the right edge. Firebreather firelight fades smoothly.

New Archer Post look (outfits by level, real bows, L5 banners and slit archers). Hordes: extra income, half bounty, horde armor bar. New units Knight, Scout Troop, Footman Warband; tougher 10-zombie hordes; Ogre/zombies/skeletons unlock at 2:00; Sapper 40g no income. New hoarding counter. Attacker panel collapses and the base can be scrolled into view.
Big units now shatter into frozen flesh chunks when the Frost Obelisk kills them, and leave smoking charred skeletons when burned (golems melt).

Burned big units now burn down top to bottom, revealing a charred skeleton inside that collapses into a smoking pile. Firebreather torch glow stays bright behind the fire. Attacker starts with 30g, earns nothing during setup, and gets a fresh hoarding grace each send window.
Hoarding counter now rises whenever the attacker holds more than 60g (no more dodging it with cheap sends). Footman 5g (175 HP), Footman Warband 25g, Scout 2g, Scout Troop 10g.

New starting towers: Stone Thrower (cavemen, 5 levels; promotes into the Archer Post) and Pterodactyl Roost (boulder drops, 5 levels; promotes into the Bombard). Promotions now work. Bombard shells land on a fixed spot with a smaller blast. Firebreather relights his torches after 4.5s of fire. AI defenders cast spells only in emergencies. Gold chip no longer overlaps the menu button on phones.

Thrown stones are slower and outlined (slings keep the fast throw). Promotions now start the new tower at level 1; levels past the requirement are credited at 70% against the cost. Archer Post rebalanced as a second stage (stronger, pricier levels).
Lanes are no longer assigned to players: build anywhere; lanes are just Lane 1-4. Main menu tagline text removed. Tapping a tower card no longer builds it by accident.

Pterodactyl is drawn in your colour. Its boulders are bigger, jagged slate grey with an outline, tumble as they fall and shatter into shards with a crater mark; boulder kills throw bodies less than a Bombard. No lane labels on the map.

Every promotion now needs level 5: Archer Post 130g (harder-hitting arrows, new level costs), Bombard 150g (more damage, splash, range). Bigger early pterodactyl roost and bird; boulder splash centred on where it lands, craters under units. Tower cards same size, no shadow.

New mode: Knight Brawl, 2-player online co-op (or solo) as Sword-in-the-Stone knights: move/swing sticks, directional swings, 4-turn light-sword spin, spawn footmen, zombies, ogres and warg riders, shared slow-mo.
Knight Brawl: aimed dashing slice with a growing blade-slice effect, leap slam (flips, 45° dive, blade buried at the centre, splash + knockback + crater), pinch zoom, Menu button.

Knight Brawl: endless path with horde spawner (A few / Dozens / Hundreds, pick enemy mix), 8 new enemy types incl. exploding sapper, bigger + 40% stronger basic swings, smoother dash/leap/spin chaining, dash runs straight into movement.
Knight Brawl: health bars only on damaged enemies.
Knight Brawl: sound effects (swings, spin, dash, leap slam, sword pull, hits, kills, sapper blasts), looping music, Sound/Music toggles, Spawn now +50.
Knight Brawl: music starts when the first knight pulls his sword.
Knight Brawl: music volume slider, leap button moved right next to swing, swing/dash closer to the edge, no clink on sword pull or dash.
Knight Brawl: Spin button centred vertically in landscape.
Knight Brawl: 'Exit to main menu?' confirmation on the Menu button.
Knight Brawl: basic swing glows like the spin with the spin's reach and a wide cleave (no hit cap), 20% slower; page reloads itself on new versions.

Knight Brawl: giant ultimate (250 kills, 12s, charged leap once, end slam), swing hits follow the glowing blade, control layout editor, cooldowns spin 6s / dash 2s / leap 7s, faster spin movement, skeletons off by default.

Knight Brawl: new playable Firebreather (torch swings throwing fire waves, Breath stick, Plume flight, Coals sprint), character picker, per-character control layouts, mass-kill bodies all fly, draggable music slider + Music button.

Knight Brawl: Firebreather breath on the main stick with charge + heat, Lava beam button, wider coal beds, Volcano ult (tap to fire up to 5 molten rocks, everyone zooms out), camera starts fully zoomed out, bot round script.
Volcano: ring of fire burns enemies crowding its base, rocks land exactly where tapped (no clamp to the field, never dropped on a slow frame), help text hidden on the volcano.
Ult cost per character (Knight 450 kills, Firebreather 300); volcano range and zoom-out -20%, molten rock drawn 20% bigger, blast radius +15%.
Fix taps landing below the finger on iPhone (canvas sized to its real box, taps/aim mapped through it); volcano shows a dashed range ring.
Lava: 5s window that starts with his first breath; while it runs his headdress grows with licking flames and ember tattoos glow.
Knight Brawl: up to 4 players, join mid-game, seats freed on leave, full-room message; MAX horde button; enemy cap and spawns scale with players; smaller snapshots.
Volcano: molten rock drawn 20% bigger, blast radius 25% bigger.
Knight Brawl: open-games list like Hold the Line (tap to join, shows host, characters and n/4; games stay listed while running so people can drop in); players named by character.

Knight Brawl: lava opens into a 60-degree cone at the end of its window, growing headdress flames and fire aura, golden form on press, lava breaks off and cools away, Restart button; performance after big blasts (cached body-part sprites, fewer parts/splats, no sprite rebuilds during zooms, cheaper smoke and burn flames).
Knight Brawl: the giant knight takes 65% less damage.
Knight Brawl: new character Warpriest (spiked flail dragged on a chain, censer swing, sweep, slam with go to / bring in, holy flame, Penance ult).
Warpriest: impaled bodies fly off when the ball turns; Penance aura pushes enemies out from under him.
Warpriest: sweep dial, sweep grabs enemies near him smoothly (no flash), wider pull-in and Bring in hits, Penance ends with a full smash on the head's return; taller Brawl field.
Warpriest: player-colour censer outline, pauldron skull and visor glow; big sweep cooldown 7s.
Knight Brawl: in-game character and colour select, player names over other players, Menu panel (main menu, restart, sound, music, controls, hit zones), Clear in Horde, vertical volume slider.
Knight: third swing (clockwise twirl), bigger light blade on swings 2 and 3, smoother swings, swings cut wherever the blade moves fast; Hit zones shows each swing's damage area.
Firebreather's volcano only zooms out his own screen; Warpriest chain meets the head's centre.
Enemies keep a little more room between each other
Changelog button on the main menu; switching character in Knight Brawl now loads that character's control layout
Changelog's Close button stays at the top; Warpriest Penance: enemies in the area beneath him are slowed 90% instead of pushed out, and the area is 35% bigger

New character in Knight Brawl: the Time Traveler (draft). Cane, a portal that hands him a random weapon (lightsaber, shotgun, tentacled alien, saw-blade gun) with its own ability, and a motorcycle he summons from a portal; Knight's spin is 30% bigger

Knight: spin speeds you up, longer and wider dash with a glowing blade, no stopping before a dash or leap, leap reaches 20% further, faster recovery after the slam. Time Traveler: saber boomerang throw, bike tweaks

Time Traveler: lightsaber ability now calls down an airship that crashes, burns, explodes and throws burning wreckage that hurts what it lands on; his bike rams enemies on its way to him; test buttons hidden. Bodies fade out smoothly instead of popping away
Time Traveler: the airship's crash area is now long like the ship and 20% bigger

Smoother on big/high-refresh PC screens (FPS readout in Menu). Time Traveler: tossing the alien brings a second one (the first moves on the circle), bike and portal buttons cancel, the bike rams enemies and can't miss him, smooth bike landing, weapons come through the portal, the fallen ship blocks the way
Time Traveler: every weapon comes up at least once every 5 portals

Time Traveler: ult Prehistoric Stampede (dinosaur herd through a portal); shotgun ability Strafe (draw a strip, a helicopter door gunner rakes it from a portal); weapons come out of the portal properly

Big Hold the Line enemies join the horde; bigger horde sizes (Swarm, Thousands, Apocalypse); new Characters screen; Warpriest is unstoppable, censer holy fire burns 5% max hp/s; Time Traveler: new ult Time Ride (car, dinosaurs, spacecraft), wake-up animation, hidden behind the watch; Firebreather plume lands cleanly
Knight's ult no longer zooms the camera out
Ults cost 3x the kills; Time Traveler is a regular character, ride shortened, weapons last 14s; Warpriest holy fire and slam toned down; Firebreather's volcano blasts enemies away as it sinks
